author: Antigravity Engineering
description: A fully local, lightweight Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built without LangChain or LlamaIndex.

components.document_loader: Extracts text from markdown, text, csv, and json formats with UTF-8 encoding.
components.splitter: Recursive text chunker maintaining configurable chunk size (500 chars) and overlap (100 chars) to prevent context fragmentation.
components.embedding_engine: Ollama local API generating dense vector representations with 768 dimensions using embeddinggemma.
components.vector_store: Custom in-memory index featuring exact cosine similarity search and persistent JSON disk caching.
components.llm_generator: Ollama local inference engine running llama3.2 (3B parameters) with streaming token support and strict source grounding.

advantages: Zero external vendor lock-in or cloud subscription fees
Complete data privacy since all documents and prompts remain on localhost
Fast execution without heavy abstraction layers or dependency conflicts
Transparent math and clear debugging paths
